Perfect! I've successfully created a dynamic lab members section for your Hugo website. Here's what I've implemented:

## Summary of Changes:

### 1. **New Hugo Shortcodes Created:**
- **`lab-member-card.html`**: Creates individual lab member cards with photo, name, and title
- **`lab-members.html`**: Container that creates the responsive grid layout

### 2. **CSS Styling Added:**
- **Responsive grid layout** using CSS Grid (`auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)`)
- **Card styling** with hover effects and rounded corners
- **Mobile responsiveness** with different grid configurations for various screen sizes:
  - Desktop: Cards automatically fit with minimum 250px width
  - Tablet: Cards minimum 200px width with reduced spacing  
  - Mobile: Single column layout

### 3. **Updated People Page:**
- Added "Lab Members" section below Principal Investigator
- Included Seth Eisenberg (Research Specialist) and Alex Bonadio (Postdoctoral Fellow)
- Used placeholder SVG images you can replace with actual photos

### 4. **Key Features:**
- **Dynamic responsiveness**: More/fewer cards per row based on window size
- **Consistent styling**: Matches your existing design system
- **Scalable**: Easy to add more lab members by adding more `lab-member-card` shortcodes
- **No HTML in markdown**: Follows Hugo best practices using shortcodes

## How to Use:

To add more lab members, simply add more `lab-member-card` shortcodes within the `lab-members` container:

```markdown
{{< lab-members >}}
{{< lab-member-card 
    image="/images/member-photo.jpg"
    name="Member Name"
    title="Position Title"
>}}
{{< /lab-members >}}
```

## Next Steps:

1. Replace the placeholder SVG images (`seth-eisenberg-placeholder.svg` and `alex-bonadio-placeholder.svg`) with actual photos in the `/static/images/` directory
2. The grid will automatically adjust to show 1-4 cards per row depending on screen size
3. You can easily add more lab members by following the same pattern

The lab members section now provides a clean, professional, and responsive display that will work beautifully on all devices!
